simple.meaning: תְּרוּעָה (tᵉrûwʻâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “clamor , i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry ; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 36 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 9 more, beginning at Leviticus 23:24. Its contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּרוּעָה (H8643).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: clamor , i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry ; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum
